breadcrumb: Services > Agentic AI & Hyperautomation > Process & Task Mining
meta_description: Process & Task Mining from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: The honest pitch for process & task mining fits in a sentence — See the work as it actually runs — event-log truth before you automate anything. — and the rest of this page is the how: measured baseline, bounded build, evidence in flight.

Automating an imagined process is how programs waste their first year. We mine the truth from system event logs and desktop telemetry: variant analysis showing the twelve real paths where the process map shows three, bottleneck heatmaps by team and system, rework loops, and conformance gaps against policy. Task mining adds the human layer — application switching, copy-paste bridges, swivel-chair work — quantifying exactly where minutes bleed.

The output is a ranked automation portfolio with evidence: each candidate scored on frequency, variance, fragmentation and value, with a target-state design for the top flows. Clients use this as the foundation for agentic programs and as a continuous instrument post-deployment, comparing actual execution against design drift every quarter.

Process & Task Mining delivery today concentrates in Manufacturing & Industrial, Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Logistics & Supply Chain. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
